correct.zh: 正确答案是ウ。问卷请求邮件的正文中，必须完整写明调查的目的、调查对象、回答方法、截止日期这四项（这也是本题所属的中题 A 中，上司向 F 先生指示的事项的第一条）。把给出的邮件正文按要素逐一核销：目的由「本次为了改善职场环境，决定实施满意度调查」满足，调查对象由「调查对象为全体员工」满足，截止日期由「截止日期为下个月的最后一天」满足，末尾还写有咨询联系方式。也就是说，四个要素中唯一没有写到的就是回答方法，而空白处 a 正好处在填补这一空缺的位置。ウ 的「请在附件的问卷文档中填写回答，并将其作为附件附在本邮件的回复邮件中发送」，既具体说明了回答写在哪里（邮件所附的问卷文档），也具体说明了如何提交（附在这封请求邮件的回复中发送），作为回答方法的说明不多不少、恰到好处。由于它指示对方使用回复功能，员工不必担心把收件地址打错，回收一方也能确保回答邮件都准确汇集到 F 先生处，这在实务上也是一项优点。
correct.en: The correct answer is ウ. The body of an email requesting a questionnaire must state all four items without omission: the purpose of the survey, the target respondents, the response method, and the deadline (this is also the first of the items that the superior instructed Mr. F to satisfy in the multi-part question set A to which this item belongs). Checking off the given email body element by element, the purpose is covered by “This time, in order to improve the workplace environment, we have decided to conduct a satisfaction survey”, the target respondents by “The target respondents are all employees”, and the deadline by “The deadline is the last day of next month”, and the contact for inquiries is written at the end as well. In other words, the only one of the four elements that is not written is the response method, and blank a sits exactly at the position where that gap should be filled. Choice ウ, “Please fill in your answers in the attached questionnaire document, attach it to a reply to this email, and send it”, concretely conveys both where to write the answers (the questionnaire document attached to the email) and how to submit them (attach it to a reply to this request email and send it), so as a statement of the response method it is neither lacking nor excessive. Because it instructs employees to use the reply function, there is no worry that employees will mistype the destination address, and the collecting side can also reliably gather the response emails addressed to Mr. F, which is a practical advantage as well.

distractors.zh: 「请确保填写到问卷文档中的内容没有错误」只是提醒填写时要注意，完全没有告诉对方回答要写在哪份文档上、又该向何处、以何种方式提交这一最关键的步骤。即使把它填入空白处 a，回答方法依然不明，收到邮件的员工无法把回答送回来，作为请求邮件也就不能成立。作为一句提醒注意的话本身并没有错，但它没有承担空白处 a 应当承担的作用（明示缺失的回答方法），在这一点上并不恰当。
distractors.en: “Please make sure that there are no errors in the contents you fill in the questionnaire document” only urges care when filling in the form; it conveys nothing about the crucial procedure of which document the answers are to be written in, and where and how they are to be submitted. Even if it is placed in blank a, the response method remains unclear, so the employees who receive the email cannot return their answers, and the message does not work as a request email. As a sentence calling for care it is not wrong in itself, but it fails to perform the role that blank a should perform (stating the missing response method), and in that respect it is inappropriate.

distractors.zh: 「在回答截止日期的 2 天前，将向尚未回答的人员发送催促邮件」只是预告请求一方今后的运作安排，并不是对回答方法的说明。催促是人事部针对未回答者单独进行的工作，并不是发给全体员工的请求邮件正文中必须写明的要素。而且中题 A 中上司指示的是在「截止日期的 2 个工作日前」发出催促，把工作日换成单纯天数的「回答截止日期的 2 天前」这一表述，与所指示的事项也不一致。
distractors.en: “Two days before the response deadline, we will send a reminder email to those who have not responded” merely announces the requesting side's future operational plan; it is not an explanation of the response method. Sending reminders is work done individually by the Human Resources Department toward those who have not responded, and it is not an element that must be written in the body of a request email addressed to all employees. Furthermore, what the superior instructs in the multi-part question set A is to send reminders “two business days before the deadline”, so the wording “two days before the response deadline”, which replaces business days with a plain number of days, also does not match the instructed items.

distractors.zh: 「由于对象是全体员工，请务必遵守截止日期」，其前半句只不过是紧挨在前面的「调查对象为全体员工」的换一种说法，后半句的内容也与紧随其后的「截止日期为下个月的最后一天。请予以协助」重复。也就是说，它只是把已经写过的信息重复了一遍，没有增加任何一条新信息。即使填入它，回答方法依然缺失，而且重复还会使正文变得冗长，因此作为填入空白处 a 的描述并不恰当。
distractors.en: In “Since the target is all employees, please be sure to observe the deadline”, the first half is merely a paraphrase of the immediately preceding “The target respondents are all employees”, and the second half overlaps in content with the immediately following “The deadline is the last day of next month. We ask for your cooperation”. In other words, it merely repeats information that is already written and adds not a single piece of new information. Even if it is inserted, the response method is still missing, and the repetition also makes the body wordy, so it is not appropriate as the statement to put in blank a.

points.zh: 在请求邮件的正文中明确写出目的、调查对象、回答方法、截止日期这四个要素，是基本要求。这类填空题可以按下面的步骤稳妥求解：把正文中已经写到的要素逐一核销，然后选出能补上唯一缺失要素的那个选项。
points.en: It is basic practice to state four elements clearly in the body of a request email: the purpose, the target respondents, the response method, and the deadline. This kind of fill-in-the-blank question can be solved reliably by the following procedure: check off the elements already written in the body one by one, then choose the option that supplies the only element that is missing.

points.zh: 以邮件附件的方式回收问卷时，要把填写回答的对象（附件中的问卷文档）和提交的步骤（附在请求邮件的回复中发送）都具体地指示清楚。让对方使用回复邮件，既能防止收件地址写错，也便于核对是否有回收遗漏。
points.en: When questionnaires are collected as email attachments, give concrete instructions covering both what the answers are written in (the attached questionnaire document) and the procedure for submission (attach it to a reply to the request email and send it). Having respondents use a reply email prevents mistakes in writing the destination address and also makes it easier to check for responses that were not collected.
